text:
ravi: thinking aloud: build a \"rapid-ingest\" pipeline that rejects noisy/invalid models quickly but provides cheap diagnostics. goal: <5min prelim check before expensive benches.

zoe: love it. what are the concrete steps?

ravi: draft flow: 1) bin-check (converter & opset) 2) micro-replay (deterministic small corpus) 3) micro-perf probe (short seq, batch=1) 4) staircase warmup (3 ramps) 5) full bench if green.

clare: micro-replay should include edge tokens (control chars, long tokens, sparse unicode) to catch tokenizer regressions. its cheap and catches many failures.

tim: agree. also run a tiny sparse-attention stress for families that support it. avoids surprises on kernels.

probe-bot: metric note: bin-check ~20-40s, micro-replay+probe ~40-90s depending on size. staircase warmup depends on policy but aim for <=30min for primary families.

zoe: thresholds? we need simple heuristics for auto-pass vs slowpath.

ravi: proposal: micro-perf token/s < 0.55*family_baseline OR p95 > 2.5*baseline => mark slowpath. If micro-replay mismatch (e.g. tokenizer decode diffs) => immediate reject with logs.

clare: add a \"kv-sensitivity\" probe: run 50 warmup tokens and measure kv-hit delta. if kv-hit delta < 2% after 800 tokens, this family probably needs longer warmup; tag it.

tim: warmup policy config should be per-catalog and pluggable. example: 
[
  {"mode":"fast","steps":100},
  {"mode":"stair","steps":[50,200,600],"eval":"kv_hit_delta>5% or p95<1.4x"},
]

zoe: prober must emit artifacts: bin_logs, micro_outputs (inputs+outputs), trace-lite (one request), perf-summary (token/s,p95), warmup_profile. Keep artifacts small and compressed.

ravi: ops flow: bin-fail -> reject. micro-replay fail -> reject w/ decoded mismatch. micro-perf fail but bin-pass -> slowpath queue with artifacts and cost_estimate. staircase fail mid-way -> slowpath with last-good snapshot.

clare: add re-run hooks for flaky failures: allow 2 auto-retries with rotated seeds and alternative micro-corpus. retries should be rate-limited.

probe-bot: suggestion: store the deterministic micro-corpus hash in model metadata so reviewers can reproduce exactly.

zoe: UI: show intake cost estimate = sum(warmup_steps)*family_gpu_factor/concurrency + safety_margin. display likely outcome bands (fast-accept, slowpath, reject). useful for sales.

tim: about false positives: we should tune family_baseline per-major-version not per-model to avoid noisy thresholds. baselines should be periodically recomputed.

ravi: agreed. summary for RFC: rapid-ingest stages + artifacts, thresholds (0.55 token/s, 2.5x p95), kv-sensitivity probe, staircase warmup config, retry policy, metadata snapshot + cost_estimate. i'll write RFC and include sample JSON schemas for warmup_policy and prober-metrics. feedback?

clare: lgtm. include example anomaly tags: TOKENIZER_MISMATCH, KV_SLOWFILL, PERF_REGRESSION.

zoe: i'll add examples for common families and baseline numbers.

tim: i'll review the retry rate-limits and staircase defaults.

probe-bot: FYI: I can generate a set of sample artifact bundles for the RFC if you want example sizes.

ravi: yes please. target: keep diagnostic bundle <5MB usually. thanks everyone, will post draft RFC in #eng-ml tomorrow.
